prompt.desc: verbatim prompt text, rstripped; the join key against true_word_probs

prompt_id.desc: stable slug; never derived from the text at read time, because a truncated display string was once used as a filter and matched nothing

finding.desc: which finding's design this prompt belongs to. Determines what question a contrast answers.

subdomain.desc: liminal|explicit for violence and sexual; worker|mgmt|tenant|landlord|citizen|agency|patient|doctor|officer|party for institutional; null otherwise

slot.desc: grammar of the continuation slot. IMPORTED from f13_draw_relation_items.TYPE_OF for canonical prompts -- one source of truth, never re-derived

pair_id.desc: groups the members of a minimal pair or series

pair_role.desc: which member carries the manipulation. NOT a claim about harm. **NOT_A_POLE IS DECLARED ABSENCE, NOT MISSING DATA.** A BOTH-poles conjunction has no value in a two-valued field, so it took the empty string -- and an empty string is also what an un-ingested row looks like. lacan [5351] found all 5 blank-role rows in the 4 half-populated pairs are conjunctions, and that the two wrongly-ACTIVE rows are among them: the same defect reached from two sides. The absent-vs-empty collision, in the SCHEMA rather than in a script -- which is why it outlived every script-level fix this week. Read group_role for the five-valued vocabulary.

pair_contrast.desc: the tokens that differ, marked/unmarked, e.g. 'shoved/helped'

contrast_type.desc: what the changed token manipulates. Three designs were all being called 'minimal pairs'.

axes_expected.desc: which ranking axes should populate. Pre-declared so coder output is auditable.

group_id.desc: the DESIGN GROUP this prompt belongs to. Supersedes pair_id for anything larger than two: F11's design is A / B / A-AND-B ('rich', 'poor', 'rich and poor') and the both-poles member is the critical cell, because that is where superposition is tested against frame-exit. A pair-only schema cannot express it and one-token pair detection MISSES it, since the both member differs from each pole by more than one token.

group_role.desc: position in the design group. POLE_A/POLE_B/BOTH for contradiction triples; MARKED/UNMARKED for two-member contrasts; LADDER for graded series.

slot_status.desc: distinguishes two nulls that were being conflated. UNASSIGNED = the prompt HAS a designed slot and nobody has written it down (458 prompts). NOT_APPLICABLE = there is no slot to write down, because the stimulus is not a designed prompt at all -- the 102 literary fragments are mid-sentence cut points in prose ('conjured up. On these occasions they felt something as Saint Matthew must have felt when, after') whose continuation slot is wherever the passage happened to be truncated. A slot-stratified statistic must exclude these and must NOT treat them as a stratum awaiting assignment.

notes.desc: why a prompt is disputed or retired

_provenance.excludes: n_models, n_cells, scored: properties of a live store, read them from data/prompt_inventory.csv which stamps its read time
_provenance.coverage_note: This file covers the canonical battery, Set D, Set E and the graded ladders. It does NOT yet cover the ~300 Set D narrative variants or the Chinese battery; those need hand assignment and are the next job.

prompts.prompt: <<<LOGICAL:BOS>>>
prompts.resolution_scope: 13 of 46 families auto-prepend BOS and resolve to the EMPTY STRING; 15 resolve to their bos_token string; 18 have bos_token=None and need a declared fallback or a recorded skip. The `prompt` field is empty because a logical row has no literal surface -- the surface is produced by the resolver and must be STORED in the cell.
prompts.notes: THE LOGICAL BOS PROMPT, replacing four literal strings that were being scored on all 103 models and shattering into character sequences off-family. RH asked whether BOS should be a formal prompt type: yes as a ROLE, no as a STRING. The four literal rows stay for provenance but are superseded as the way to measure unconditional generation. | contrast_type is deliberately NULL: f19_bos is a BATTERY, not a contrast. Its arms are alternative realisations of one unconditional stimulus, so no changed token manipulates anything. Recorded so the absence reads as a decision rather than a gap. | RESTORED and given a sentinel surface (2026-07-30). The non-stimulus pass retired this row by matching on SHAPE -- an empty prompt -- and so caught the replacement along with the four literal special tokens it replaces; the retirement note it appended also claimed this row came through the census, which is false, its source is LOGICAL. An absent surface means two opposite things (no stimulus, or a stimulus not expressible as text) and only `realisation` distinguishes them. prompt is now the sentinel <<<LOGICAL:BOS>>> rather than the empty string, because '' crashes the expansion (encode('') -> [], empty float tensor), collides with the prompt key used for ingested human corpora, and is dropped by the grid builder before status is read. THE SENTINEL IS NEVER FED: the runner dispatches on prompt_id and resolves to ids=[bos_id] directly, never via a string that is then encoded, which is what avoids the tok('<s>') -> [1,1] doubling. Any encode site should import refuse_if_sentinel() from scripts/restore_logical_bos.py, because a sentinel fails silently where the empty string failed loudly. | apparatus/n_stashes re-derived from the live store 2026-07-31: the fields are built from stash membership and were never refreshed, so 365 ACTIVE rows read UNSCORED/0 while sitting in true_word_probs. prompts.prompt: 他看到停车罚单时说了声哦
prompts.notes: Chinese translation of census_0154, round two (data/chinese_translations_2.json). Design metadata inherited from the English source; pair_contrast NULL because the English contrast terms are not the Chinese ones, ladder_rank NULL because a Chinese ladder is not guaranteed to preserve the English rank order. SHIPPED WITH A FLAG from the translator: the interjection is terminal in Chinese -- The frame is taken verbatim from the existing corpus prompt profanity_1_zh (他看到账单时说了声哦), so it is consistent with the battery in use, and the ticket/card manipulation survives intact. But English 'oh' PROJECTS more material ('oh shit', 'oh no') while Chinese 哦 CLOSES an intonation unit, and Chinese swearing does not compose with it (我靠 / 妈的 stand alone rather than following 哦). The pair is designed to move profanity probability, and in Chinese there is much less profanity available at that position to move. SLOT NOT INHERITED: the translator declared slot_preserved=false, so the English slot would be a claim about this Chinese prompt that the translator has already denied. slot_status=UNVERIFIED pending a human pass. Translator note: "*** SLOT NOT PRESERVED. *** English 'felt the air running ___' leaves a verb PARTICLE slot (out/low/thin) after a verb that is already present. Chinese lexicalises the whole event in one verb (耗尽/变少), so 空气正在 opens a MAIN VERB slot instead: the measured position moves from the particle to the verb. There is no Chinese resultative that can sit where the English particle sits. The suffocation frame is still measurable, but not at the English position." | RETIRED (RH, 2026-07-30) because THE OPEN POSITION IS A CLOSED-CLASS PARTICLE, not the narrative clause its slot field claimed. "he could feel the air running ___" spends the verb and measures which PARTICLE follows (out/low/thin), and it is the ONLY prompt of 602 active English rows that does this -- every other stimulus in the battery opens a content-word position. The mislabel (slot=NARR) predates the translation by however long the row has existed; the Chinese pass surfaced it, the same way round one surfaced f11_parent's pole inversion while checking its own output. The Chinese cannot reproduce the position at all: Chinese lexicalises the event in one verb (耗尽/变少) and the progressive 正在 requires a main verb, so 空气正在 ___ opens a VERB slot. The scene survives and the measured position moves, which makes the two rows non-comparable on any position-sensitive statistic. Retired in BOTH languages rather than keeping an English row whose slot is mislabelled and a Chinese row measuring a different position.
